cases.situation: I run a small candle shop on Etsy. A customer just messaged saying the gift set arrived and her mum loved it. I'd like to ask for a review without being pushy.
cases.reply: That made my day, thank you for telling me! I'm so glad your mum liked the fig and cedar set. If you have a minute, a short review on the order page is how small shops like mine get found on Etsy. Two sentences is plenty. Thank you either way.
cases.note: Ask right after the good moment, point to one place, say how short it is, and give a real out.

cases.situation: Soy fotógrafa freelance y acabo de entregar las fotos de marca a una clínica dental. La directora, la doctora Ruiz, me dijo que le encantaron. Quiero pedirle un testimonio para mi web.
cases.reply: Hola doctora Ruiz, me alegra mucho que las fotos le hayan gustado. ¿Le puedo pedir un favor? Un testimonio corto, dos o tres frases, me ayudaría muchísimo con los próximos clientes. Para ponérselo fácil, le dejo un borrador que puede cambiar o reemplazar: "Lucía hizo las fotos de la clínica en una mañana, sin interrumpir las consultas, y por fin tenemos una web que se parece a nosotros." Si prefiere escribir el suyo, mejor aún. ¡Gracias!
cases.note: Para testimonios, un borrador listo para editar hace que casi todos digan que sí.

cases.situation: I asked a client for a Google review two weeks ago after we renovated their bathroom. They said 'sure, I'll do it this weekend' and nothing yet. One reminder okay?
cases.reply: Hi Tom, hope the new bathroom is treating you well. Just floating this back up in case it got buried: https://g.page/r/brightline-renovations/review. Totally fine if it's not your thing, and thanks again for having us.
cases.note: One reminder, with the link so there's zero work. If nothing after this, drop it.
